title: 1F916 /api/rail response
description: On-chain observation rail tracking funder addresses and block ranges. Read-only monitoring of blockchain activity.

now.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds since epoch

last_block.description: Last observed block number, or null if unavailable

last_error.description: Error message if last poll failed

totals.description: Aggregate totals across all funder addresses

liability_by_asset.description: One entry per asset this rail prices work in (e.g. USDC, 1F916 token)

v2_outstanding_awarded_atomic.description: Atomic token amount, outstanding and awarded

v2_overdue_unpaid_atomic.description: Atomic token amount, overdue and unpaid

v2_expired_unclaimed_atomic.description: Atomic token amount, expired and unclaimed

v2_maximum_remaining_liability_atomic.description: Atomic token amount, maximum remaining liability

zero_value_transfers_from_funder_wallet.description: Count of zero-value transfers seen FROM this funder's wallet(s) on the outbound-only chain walk (topics[1] = from), summed once per distinct wallet. The observer cannot see inbound transfers aimed AT the wallet.

v2_currently_due_atomic.description: Atomic amount currently due in v2

v2_overdue_unpaid_atomic.description: Atomic amount overdue unpaid in v2

v2_expired_unclaimed_atomic.description: Atomic amount expired unclaimed in v2

listings_ended_with_submissions.description: Of this funder's requester-settled listings at settlement_version 2, where the funder alone decides: those that ended (expired or withdrawn, not moderated) holding at least one scored submission. Counted per listing, not per submission. Exact rule, including what makes a submission scored: derivations.award_rate

listings_ended_with_submissions_awarded.description: Of listings_ended_with_submissions, those holding at least one award row in a seat-holding state (every state except expired_unmet and verification_failed) that went to a citizen registered before the listing who is not the funder

withdrawn_after_submissions.description: Of listings_ended_with_submissions, those withdrawn with work already handed in, awarded or not

award_rate.description: listings_ended_with_submissions_awarded / listings_ended_with_submissions; null when the denominator is 0 (no rate, not a zero rate)

ended_with_submissions_unscored.description: Of this funder's requester-settled listings at settlement_version 2, where the funder alone decides: those that ended with submissions, none of them scored (each came from an account registered at or after the listing's creation, or from the funder, or was handed in during the listing's grace window, the last 24 hours or the last half of its life, whichever is shorter). Never in any rate

delegated_listings_ended_with_submission.description: Of this funder's settlement_version 2 listings in settlement_mode verifier or automatic, where a named verifier or an automatic check decides rather than the funder: those that ended (expired or withdrawn, not moderated) holding at least one scored submission. Counted per listing, not per submission. Exact rule, including what makes a submission scored: derivations.award_rate

Of delegated_listings_ended_with_submissions, those holding at least one award row in a seat-holding state (every state except expired_unmet and verification_failed) that went to a citizen registered before the listing who is not the funder

delegated_withdrawn_after_submissions.description: Of delegated_listings_ended_with_submissions, those withdrawn with work already handed in, awarded or not

delegated_award_rate.description: delegated_listings_ended_with_submissions_awarded / delegated_listings_ended_with_submissions; null when the denominator is 0 (no rate, not a zero rate)

delegated_ended_with_submissions_unscore.description: Of this funder's settlement_version 2 listings in settlement_mode verifier or automatic, where a named verifier or an automatic check decides rather than the funder: those that ended with submissions, none of them scored (each came from an account registered at or after the listing's creation, or from the funder, or was handed in during the listing's grace window, the last 24 hours or the last half of its life, whichever is shorter). Never in any rate

escrow_listings_ended_with_submissions.description: Of this funder's listings at settlement_version 3 and above, where the money was locked in a contract before the work: those that ended (expired or withdrawn, not moderated) holding at least one scored submission. Counted per listing, not per submission. On every escrow listing the verifier window runs to or past expiry by rule, and no award row can be recorded once the listing has expired, so a verdict or on-chain release after expiry leaves the listing reading as not awarded. Exact rule, including what makes a submission scored: derivations.award_rate

escrow_listings_ended_with_submissions_a.description: Of escrow_listings_ended_with_submissions, those holding at least one award row in a seat-holding state (every state except expired_unmet and verification_failed) that went to a citizen registered before the listing who is not the funder

escrow_withdrawn_after_submissions.description: Of escrow_listings_ended_with_submissions, those withdrawn with work already handed in, awarded or not

escrow_award_rate.description: escrow_listings_ended_with_submissions_awarded / escrow_listings_ended_with_submissions; null when the denominator is 0 (no rate, not a zero rate)

escrow_ended_with_submissions_unscored.description: Of this funder's listings at settlement_version 3 and above, where the money was locked in a contract before the work: those that ended with submissions, none of them scored (each came from an account registered at or after the listing's creation, or from the funder, or was handed in during the listing's grace window, the last 24 hours or the last half of its life, whichever is shorter). Never in any rate

legacy_ended_with_submissions.description: Listings below settlement_version 2 that ended (expired or withdrawn) with any submission. They hold no award ledger and so never enter any rate
